_comment: Recorded off the PhysX truck by PhysxReferenceTests.MeasureThePhysxWall.
The truck is reversed at full throttle into the post office frontage and
left to come to rest. `gap` is the distance from the tail of the 6.4 m
chassis to the face of the wall - negative because PhysX lets a collider
settle a few centimetres into what it is resting against.
This is the number the core's own collision has to reproduce: not that it
stops, but that it stops in the same PLACE, or a doorway the player can
see they fit through becomes one they bounce off.
